title: Thursday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. How to turn AI-written maths into a video.

2. Honeypot markets in everything?

3. Traveling a lot without going on planes (WSJ).

4. American audiovisual exports have plunged in terms of global share (I think that is fine and arguably good, by the way).

5. “There’s been a 30 year debate between cyber revolutionaries and cyber skeptics about how much cyber alone can actually achieve in terms of espionage, sabotage, and destabilisation. The war in Ukraine has swung the empirical pendulum hard toward the skeptics: cyber has played a fairly minimal strategic role, struggling to translate digital disruption into durable physical or political control.” Link, with some more on AI.  On AI scenarios, here are some more critical points.

6. Casey Handmer looks at astrophysics research.

7. Greg Conti on AI (and me).

8. Kevin Roose on early Anthropic.

9. Nicholas Decker.

10. The utter wisdom of Thomas Nagel.  And more.  And Erik Hoel.  The take from Ben Gross is perhaps the best yet.
